body:
I think that it would be easier to handle it like this:
```suggestion
    let display_style = config
        .display
        .iter()
        .filter(|display_style| percentage <= display_style.threshold as f32)
        .min_by_key(|display_style| display_style.threshold)?;
```

The Iterator API never cease to amaze me... I blame my lack of sleep for not looking through the Iterator docs a little more closely for this function. That is indeed a lot cleaner and more concise though, I'll update it later today when I have a break at work.
